description: This Java class 'MockMode' provides a central toggle for enabling or disabling API test 'mock/demo mode'. It determines whether the testing environment should make real HTTP calls or return mocked responses, based on system properties or environment variables.

classes.name: MockMode
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to check if mock mode is enabled based on system properties or environment variables.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks various system properties and environment variables to determine if mock/demo mode should be enabled.

methods.name: parseBoolean
methods.description: Parses a string value to return true if it represents a boolean 'true' equivalent.
